vintage: Eurostat regional statistics: population on 1 January 2025, GDP and jobs 2023
name: Europe

yields.label: Food
yields.description: Jobs in agriculture, forestry and fishing, counted where people work, self-employed included (Eurostat regional accounts, employment by NUTS 3 region).

yields.label: Production
yields.description: Jobs in industry (manufacturing, mining, energy, water) and construction, counted where people work, self-employed included (Eurostat regional accounts, employment by NUTS 3 region).

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Annual gross domestic product in current euros (Eurostat, GDP of NUTS 3 regions). A city's GDP is the sum, over its regions, of the regional GDP times the share of the region's population living in the urban area (local administrative units, 2021 census).

yields.label: Science
yields.description: Jobs in professional, scientific and technical activities (research and development, engineering, consulting, support services) and in information and communication, counted where people work, self-employed included (Eurostat regional accounts, employment by NUTS 3 region).

yields.label: Culture
yields.description: Jobs in arts, entertainment, recreation and other services (Eurostat does not split them for regions), counted where people work, self-employed included (Eurostat regional accounts, employment by NUTS 3 region).
